mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_definition WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND trigger_type IN ('ONCE', 'CRON') AND next_trigger_at IS NOT NULL AND next_trigger_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_trigger_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_definition ( user_id, name, description, handler_type, trigger_type, cron_expression, timezone, next_trigger_at, payload, max_retries, status, idempotency_key ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{handlerType}, #{triggerType}, #{cronExpression}, #{timezone}, #{nextTriggerAt}, CAST(#{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON), #{maxRetries}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey} )
mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, description, handler_type, trigger_type, cron_expression, timezone, next_trigger_at, payload, max_retries, status, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(scheduled_at) FROM task_instance WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
